requirement_evidence.text: Scope and Snapshot are frozen; manifest/artifact hashes and metric schema are validated. Only scoped immutable bytes enter the fixed parameterized SQL worker. Account/date escapes, changed publication, returned-dict mutation and cross-scope evidence tests pass.

Four read-only tools with exact request fields and empty parameters. Invalid JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite values, SQL/shell/network/write tools and injection are refused before worker execution; invalid requests close the session.

Action, tool, protocol-token, row, input/output and wall limits are enforced. Repeated immutable tools terminate with no_progress. Real owned scripted subprocess timeout/cancel/crash tests verify kill/reap and concurrent dispatch refusal.

Numerical claims must exactly match issued metric evidence. Supported comparisons require metrics/quality/freshness. Incomplete, stale and zero-spend cases abstain; causality is unknown and proposed actions are empty. Unsupported conclusions and forged facts are rejected.

Additive diagnose CLI tested in new processes: valid request has empty stderr/code 0; unauthorized tool, invalid JSON and scope widening have structured stderr/nonzero code. Product bytes unchanged. Existing CLI/API regressions pass in full suite.

auditable_defaults.source: brief requires limit categories without numeric values
auditable_defaults.decision: Local engineering ceilings: 1 account, 31 dates/rows, 8 actions, 6 calls, 30s session, 5s tool, 4096 input bytes, 16384 output bytes, 32768 conservative protocol token units; callers can only tighten. These are not user-supplied thresholds.

No LLM execution, graph, cloud, promotion criteria or future-AC implementation added. UTF-8 protocol debit is not actual model token telemetry; inference owner must separately enforce tokenizer budgets.
